title: Assistant Professor (Tenure Track) of Earth and Planetary Evolution
institution: ETH Zurich, Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences (D-EAPS)
about: ETH Zurich's Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences seeks an Assistant Professor (Tenure Track) of Earth and Planetary Evolution, covering processes shaping Earth, rocky planets, icy moons and exoplanets, with teaching including the MSc in Space Systems. Apply online by 15 December 2026.
requirements: Expertise in computational geophysics, planetary science or a related field, with multi-physics modelling skills
No more than eight years since the doctoral examination at the time of application
card_alt: Card for the Assistant Professor (Tenure Track) of Earth and Planetary Evolution at ETH Zurich, Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences (D-EAPS), Zurich, Switzerland; deadline 15 Dec 2026. The photo shows the Matterhorn above the village of Zermatt with a Swiss flag, not Zurich.
